---
New in 1.14.0:
- Added a story progression check for the Ridgeside Village Ninja Board to prevent early game spoilers.
- Added configuration options to disable the Ninja Board check or manually update its unlock ID.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tw3u1I4.png[/img]
- Added visual feedback for menu tabs combining color tinting and spatial offset to indicate the active menu.
---
New in 1.13.0:  
Added a custom Stats menu to the Iridium Board. This new tab displays a lifetime counter for 6 different types of completed quests and special orders.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/635c5bk.png[/img]
Added a failsafe mechanism for custom textures. The game will no longer crash if alternative image files are missing
---
New in 1.12.0: 
Alternative graphics have been added. Can be enabled in the settings. Thanks @[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/notbelovely]notbelovely[/url]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/82MGNGe.png[/img]
---
New in 1.11.0: 
Turkish translation added. Thanks @[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/EmreHQ]EmreHQ[/url]﻿

Robots drive out of their garages every hour to mow grass in a fixed radius and store hay directly in your silo.
